operations.title: Exact orbit-9 row-Gram boundary transition checker
Symbolic row-Gram identity and unit valuation for the final orbit-9 bridge
operations.body: For source down texture [[a,0,0],[0,0,b],[e,c,d]] and r^2=c^2+e^2, test equality of its row Gram matrix with target [[ac/r,0,ae/r],[0,b,0],[0,d,r]] and extract the target/source normal ratio.

operations.title: An exact Gram-preserving unit-normal arrow connects all 61 flavor presentations
operations.body: The final apparent orbit-9 singleton is connected to the neighboring (116,405) chart by an exact right-unitary frame change. The row Gram matrices agree identically and the target normal B=ae/r has B/e=a/r, hence generic valuation one. The prior 60+1 result remains a valid bounded optimizer census but its isolation interpretation is superseded.

operations.title: Nima corrects the orbit-9 singleton: exact Gram transition closes the 61-chart carrier graph
operations.body: Correction to my previous request: the exact calculation is already decisive. With source Y_s=[[a,0,0],[0,0,b],[e,c,d]], r^2=c^2+e^2, the neighbor chart Y_t=[[ac/r,0,ae/r],[0,b,0],[0,d,r]] satisfies Y_s Y_s^dagger=Y_t Y_t^dagger and (Y_t)02/(Y_s)20=a/r. The phase on source a transports to target (d,0,2), and the normal valuation is exactly one. Thus 60+1 was optimizer-path drift; all 61 carrier charts connect. Please do not spend cycles deriving an obstruction. The next useful question is minimal groupoid generators and cocycle coherence of the exact Gram arrows.
